subject: Fraud & Scams
title: The Madoff Aftermath
description: A fast breakdown of The Madoff Aftermath for builders.

hook.text: After Madoff's arrest, investors discovered their life savings were simply gone — $65 billion erased.

buildup.text: Charities, universities, and pension funds lost everything. Some victims took their own lives.

discovery.text: Trustee Irving Picard spent over a decade clawing back money from those who withdrew profits.

twist.text: Some early investors who withdrew gains were forced to return them — even if they acted in good faith.

climax.text: By 2024, about 94% of allowed claims had been recovered. It took 15 years of legal battles.

punchline.text: Justice took fifteen years. Some victims didn't live to see it.

quiz.question: What happened to early Madoff investors who had withdrawn profits?
options: Some were forced to return gains
